Credits
Content

All text, figures, tables and citations: Group 6, IBRD and its Development Project Financing Activities in Vietnam (NEU, Hanoi, 2026). Bullets condense the paper; full verbatim text is in the presenter notes (N) and reading mode.

Typefaces (SIL Open Font License 1.1)

Cormorant and Cormorant SC (Christian Thalmann), Be Vietnam Pro (Lâm Bảo, Tony Le, ViệtAnh Nguyễn), IBM Plex Mono and IBM Plex Sans symbol subset (IBM). Self-hosted from the @fontsource and @ibm npm packages.

Graphics

All engravings, patterns, stamps, seals, charts and 3D objects were drawn for this deck in code (SVG and Three.js procedural geometry). No logo of the World Bank, IBRD or NEU is used. Paper, watercolour and grain textures are generated from procedural noise.

Map data

Vietnam silhouette (decorative only): Natural Earth 1:50m admin-0 countries, public domain, via the world-atlas npm package (ISC).

Software

Three.js (MIT), Vite (MIT), js-yaml (MIT). 3D environment lighting: Three.js RoomEnvironment (procedural, no HDRI file).

Style references

Two images supplied by the group were studied for style only; nothing from them is reproduced.
